title: The Sneaky LOI Clause That Could Cost You $500K
description:
If you're selling your accounting firm and scanning letters of intent (LOIs) like it's a beauty pageant for purchase prices… we need to talk.

In this video, I break down what actually matters in an LOI, and it’s not just that flashy $3 million number at the top. From working capital reductions that quietly cut your check to the misunderstood (but potentially magical) world of rollover equity, this episode is packed with the real questions sellers should be asking before they pick a buyer.

You’ll learn:
✔️ Why a $2.5M offer might be better than a $3M one
✔️ How to evaluate working capital clauses hiding in plain sight
✔️ What rollover equity actually means—and when it’s worth betting on
✔️ How to compare equity in a parent company vs. a new entity
✔️ What "second bite at the apple" means (and how to make it sweet)

Whether you're selling soon or just want to understand how the big kids do deals, this is must-know material for anyone buying or selling a business, especially in the red-hot accounting practice market.
